coverageNote: 36 public personal-holder records: 35 dated provider cross-checks and one unresolved TNA record. June 2026 remains the matched date for 28 companies; five matched September observations and two explicitly dated March observations are retained. TNA providers label their projected post-IPO snapshot Sep-26, without an independently checked final allotment or exact reporting day, so its headline percentage and quantity are withheld. Percentages are ownership of each company, not portfolio allocation. Seema Goel and family/associate positions are excluded. No original NSE XML was independently inspected in this run. Uncorroborated share counts are withheld. GK Consultants is excluded because its promoter record is identified elsewhere as Late Anil Kumar Goel, an unresolved namesake identity. Public thresholds and missing filings prevent a complete or live portfolio claim.
